desc: Derive and verify the formula: total = m*D0 + sum_{j} (m-j+1)*delta_j, prove sorting deltas ascending is optimal (exchange argument).
Handle edge cases: m=0 (answer 0), positions already 1 flipped to 0 give negative delta, 0->1 give positive delta; extra flips suboptimal.
Implement O(N log N) solution: read input, compute D0 = sum A_i*C_i, collect deltas for mismatch positions, sort, compute weighted sum with Python ints.
Test on samples: sample1 (expect 16), sample2 (0), sample3 (2867); also brute-force small random cases against permutation enumeration to validate.
Write final Python solution with fast I/O (sys.stdin), careful with large answer magnitude.
